commands.flowerbed.pvp.get.success.gamer: Your PvP will be toggled %s if per player PvP becomes enabled
commands.flowerbed.pvp.toggle.success.en: You may only attack players with %s suffixed to their nameplate
PvP between you and other PvP enabled players will be enabled if per player PvP becomes enabled
commands.flowerbed.pvp.toggle.success.di: All PvP towards you will be disabled if per player PvP becomes enabled
commands.flowerbed.pvp.toggle.failed.sou: You may only toggle PvP for yourself
commands.flowerbed.pvp.toggle.failed.non: You may not toggle PvP on a non player entity
commands.flowerbed.shrug.failed.no_serve: You are (somehow) not connected to a server. Congratulations! This should never ever happen, yet you somehow beat the odds and did it anyway. Tiny Pineapple is disappointed in you. Do you feel happy with yourself, you monster?
gamerule.flowerbed:per_player_pvp.descri: Modifies PvP to be an opt in system via the /pvp toggle command.
gamerule.flowerbed:disable_exhaustion.de: Disables entirely passive forms of hunger loss, including non-saturation based healing.
gamerule.flowerbed:disable_entering_port: Disables entering Nether and End Portals.
